notes.title: Why is our game delayed?
notes.content:
Because we are shaping our game to your wishes. We update our game all the time. We correct the mistakes and add new attachments to the game.

Recent Updates;

We've completely changed the weapons. 
We've fixed the weapon animations and we're new.
We brought innovations such as breaking the doors, breaking the windows, bursting the barrels.
We have added features such as class selection, class weapon replacement. 
We have made the panel design more beautiful. 

What we have in mind and future updates;

Adding a driving system to the game.
Adding character voices in the game.
Adding a different map.
Adding more countries.
Adding more game modes.
Adding character customization system (Clothing etc.)
Adding new weapons
